title: DTEP Public Record
description: Public DTEP-F JSON object representing one transaction in the DRRDB public level. Contains the six ontological sets M0-M5. No subject identifiers. Signed by Taler Exchange.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Must include DTEP-F context URI.

id.description: Unique record identifier. URN UUID format.

m0.description: Taler coin commitment representing the invoice identifier. Cryptographically unlinkable without Taler Exchange access.

commitment.description: Taler blind signature coin commitment. Base64url encoded.

exchange.description: Taler Exchange instance URI that generated this commitment.

m1.description: Temporal node. ISO 8601 hourly bucket. Not personal data.

issuance_bucket.description: Invoice issuance time quantised to hourly bucket. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:00:00Z.

tax_event_bucket.description: Tax event time quantised to hourly bucket. Must be >= issuance_bucket.

cpv_code.description: Eight-digit CPV code with check digit. Format: XXXXXXXX-X.

cpv_description.description: Optional human-readable CPV description. Not used in analytical primitives.

m3.description: NACE sectoral classification of seller. Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006.

nace_code.description: NACE Rev. 2 code. Division level minimum (e.g. C10), class level preferred (e.g. C10.1).

m4.description: NACE sectoral classification of buyer. Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006.

nace_code.description: NACE Rev. 2 code. Division level minimum (e.g. G47), class level preferred (e.g. G47.1).

amount.description: Transaction amount as decimal string with exactly two decimal places. Tax exclusive amount per EN 16931 BT-109.

currency.description: Currency. Fixed to EUR per DTEP-F v0.1.

vat_rate.description: Optional VAT rate as percentage decimal string (e.g. 20.00).

invoice_lifecycle.description: EN 16931 invoice lifecycle event type. Default: issuance.

proof.description: Taler Exchange Ed25519 signature over the canonicalised public record (RFC 8785 JCS).

verificationMethod.description: Taler Exchange signing key DID or URL reference.
